children: Peak XV Partners sold shares worth more than Rs 1,756 crore in Billionbrains Garage Ventures, the parent company of stockbroker Groww, through open-market transactions on September 17.
Shares of Groww's parent company fell 3.96 percent to Rs 189.76 after opening lower and extended their decline for the second consecutive session.

Peak XV Partners Investments VI-1, an investment fund owned by venture capital firm Peak XV Partners, offloaded 9.17 crore equity shares, representing a 1.46 percent stake in Billionbrains Garage Ventures, for Rs 1,756.2 crore. The shares were sold at Rs 191.49 apiece.
This represented a portion of the 15.68 percent stake held by Peak XV Partners in Groww's parent company.
Groww Mutual Fund buys 0.6% stake in Kanohar Electricals
Groww Mutual Fund acquired 4.75 lakh shares, representing a 0.6 percent stake in Kanohar Electricals, the power transformer maker, for Rs 35.2 crore.
The shares were purchased at Rs 740.38 apiece. The stock rallied 18.9 percent to Rs 751.5 on the National Stock Exchange, compared with its issue price of Rs 632.
First Bridge India Growth Fund, Authum Investment, CSIM India Opportunities Fund buy 2.42% stake in Glass Wall Systems

First Bridge India Growth Fund, promoted by private equity firm First Bridge Investment Managers, acquired an additional 6.03 lakh shares, or a 0.68 percent stake, in Glass Wall Systems, the facade solutions company, for Rs 12 crore at Rs 198.75 per share. The fund held a 2.19 percent stake in the company when its shares were listed on the bourses on Wednesday.

Authum Investment & Infrastructure bought 10 lakh shares for Rs 19.31 crore at Rs 193.12 per share, while CSIM India Opportunities Fund 1 purchased 5.25 lakh shares for Rs 10.2 crore at Rs 194.31 per share. S I Investments Broking acquired 5 lakh shares for Rs 10.19 crore at Rs 203.81 per share.

title: Peak XV Partners sells Rs 1,756 crore worth of Billionbrains Garage shares; Groww MF buys 0.6% stake in Kanohar Electricals
